overlaps.rationale: Academic year is a year-long period of organized study, distinct from a university as an institution.
Academic year is the overall study period, whereas academic subject is a field studied within it.
School break is a shorter interruption within the academic year, not the full year-long study period.
Tuition fee is a payment for study, not the academic-calendar period itself.
Last year is a relative calendar period; academic year is an organized educational period that may not align exactly with the calendar year.
Next year is a relative calendar period; academic year is an organized educational period that may not align exactly with the calendar year.
